description: Run the standard quality passes over work just done — `/dry`, then `/tend-prose` — scoped to what the branch has changed since it was last polished, committing what they change. These are the passes `/go` runs at its Step 3; this skill is how work that never went through `/go` gets them. Invoke as `/polish [focus guidance]`, or `/polish full` to re-read the branch's whole diff against its base rather than only what it changed since the last polish commit. Use when the operator says "polish this", "tidy this up", or "run the checks that come after `/go`".
